exceptions.reason: No patched npm release exists: latest is 2.0.2, and both advisories affect <=2.0.2. Upgrading or downgrading within published versions does not remediate. A custom parser fork is not currently validated against the upstream toolchains.
exceptions.risk: Malformed ICNS/JXL/HEIF input can hang the Node event loop. Browser uses this through web-ext/addons-linter; Expo uses Metro during asset bundling. These are build/development paths, not application image-upload services. Untrusted PR assets can still cause CI denial of service. Read-only validation credentials and bounded job timeouts limit impact; downstream use on untrusted runtime images is outside this exception.
